## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: Healthcare, Energy and Consumer Staples are ABOVE TREND while Technology and Financials show mixed CORRECTION/B ELOW TREND signals; Leadership concentrated in Staples/Materials/Healthcare (Leadership: Concentrated — 3 sectors in Top 5), style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: EOG (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +5.20%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +12.95%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples posting outsized moves: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, TGT (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +23.97%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weakest: VST (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -19.39%) BELOW TREND. Industrials soft with ETN (1W: -7.16% | 1M: +1.23%) CORRECTION and LMT (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND. Technology mixed to weak: NVDA (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +26.88%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -9.27%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND; MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND; NEM (1W: +11.74% | 1M: +38.91%) ABOVE TREND; DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5) — cyclicals and defensives both present.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND; AMD (1W: -8.00% | 1M: -12.31%) BELOW TREND; WMT (1W: -9.82% | 1M: -4.11%) BELOW TREND; VST (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -19.39%) BELOW TREND; LMT (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Tech/Utilities/selected Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W momentum: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +11.74% | 1M: +38.91%) ABOVE TREND, CRM (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +33.29%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence across big names (MSFT, NVDA, AAPL, AMZN, JPM showing 1W vs 1M sign flips) — tactical caution, watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is mixed-to-correcting: NVDA (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +26.88%) CORRECTION, AAPL (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -3.74%) RECOVERY, META (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -9.27%) BELOW TREND. Sector showing internal rotation; monitor big-cap divergences before committing fresh exposure.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials soft/rotational: JPM (1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION, V (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +5.73%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +9.49%) ABOVE TREND. Breadth mixed and leadership split between payments and regional banks — style mixed, not a clear Value push.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare constructive: MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +4.23%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -2.89% | 1M: -7.90%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth skewed positive and acting as a defensive growth sleeve within the NEUTRAL regime.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Healthcare and selective Energy/Materials leaders (MRK, DHR, FCX, NEM) while reducing exposure to names with clear 1W/1M divergences in Tech and select Industrials (MSFT, NVDA, LMT). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; stay selective and watch for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND — follow-through on beat/guide; FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND — materials momentum. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND — downside momentum; META (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -9.27%) BELOW TREND — legal/sentiment risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (Breadth: sector trading constructive) — leaders showing accumulation. BEARISH: Utilities and Industrials — Utilities BROAD weakness and Industrials showing trend exhaustion in several large caps (ETN, BA).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA resistance test near recent swing high (CORRECTION to clear for broader tech risk-off signal), AAPL support at recent pullback (RECOVERY needs 1M confirmation), MRK breakout continuation above 1M highs (ABOVE TREND continuation), INTC downside momentum below last-month lows (BELOW TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
DE (+80): Deere — raised 2026 net income guidance; DE (1W: +6.3% noted in news) showing follow-through (confirmation/divergence: short-term positive vs union headlines). PM (+80): Philip Morris — strong Q2 and ZYN news; PM (1W/1M not listed above) sentiment confirmed by price strength in staples. V (+55): Visa (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +5.73%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by payments strength.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UBER (-70): near-large fine headline; UBER (1W/1M not in top lists) sentiment is a material catalyst to watch. META (-55): Meta (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -9.27%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price both negative (confirmation). BAC (-55): Bank of America under SEC scrutiny; BAC (1W/1M not shown in detail) sentiment adds risk to Financials’ mixed picture.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. MRK, EL, FCX, NEM, DHR showing relative strength (ABOVE TREND). Key risk: major 1W/1M divergences among big-cap Tech and select Financials (MSFT, NVDA, AAPL, JPM) and negative headlines on META/BAC warrant monitoring.
